metadata.description: 21-agent Claude Code pipeline for viral product launches: deep research, manager-critiqued hooks, weapons-checked body, mom-test, multi-channel delivery.

plugins.name: viral-launch-pipeline
plugins.description: One orchestrator skill that fires 21 sub-agents in sequence: Brand Brief → Keywords → YouTube/X/Reddit/Industry research (parallel) → Research Compiler → Hook Writer + Manager → Giveaway Writer + Manager → Call Supervisor (mid) → Body Writer + Weapons/Controversy/Technical/Flow specialists + Body Manager → Mom Test → Call Supervisor (late) → Final Review → multi-channel Deliver (X-thread + LinkedIn post + ProductHunt). Manager loops max 3 iterations, Mom Test 1 kickback, full paper trail, resumable.
